create_IncrementalPCA: create an IncrementalPCA model with n_components and batch_size to fit-transform large datasets in batches
create_PCA: create a PCA model with n_components to fit-transform data and extract principal components
load_iris: load the iris dataset and access its data and target arrays for dimensionality reduction

visualize_transformed_data: visualize PCA and IncrementalPCA transformed iris data with colored scatter plots
